operations.text:
- Step 1: write acceptance tests first in specs/test_artefacts/acceptance/test_e2_s2_apply.py (AC1-AC5), run record-at-red.js while red; API tests in backend/tests/api/test_applications.py
- Step 2: add migration backend/migrations/0003_applications_and_documents.sql (applications and application_documents tables, DRAFT status, raw PAN/Aadhaar stored but never returned)
- Step 3: add backend/src/truelend/repository/applications_repo.py (insert_application, get with ownership filter) and backend/src/truelend/repository/documents_repo.py (insert_checklist rows MISSING)
- Step 4: add backend/src/truelend/service/application_service.py (apply: range-validate amount and tenure with Decimal against policy_service active catalog, PAN and Aadhaar format check, masking, checklist from required_documents; non-owner raises not-found)
- Step 5: add backend/src/truelend/api/applications_router.py (CUSTOMER-only POST /api/applications, GET /api/applications/{id} returning 404 for non-owners) and register it in backend/src/truelend/api/main.py; add error codes in backend/src/truelend/types/errors.py
